title: Supported State — structural placeholder
description: Subjects of a representation of a Locality's supported present posture; the representation is not State itself.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

locality.description: Exact Locality in which the represented posture is held.

temporal_scope.description: Occurrence or time for which support is claimed; a historical record does not establish currentness.

posture.description: Supported posture at the declared scope, distinct from a record or unsupported claim.

applicable_law.description: Recoverable applicable law and its exact local basis, without adoption by reference alone.

support.description: Attributable basis and evidence for the represented posture.

consequences.description: Material consequences returned to State at the smallest truthful scale, including unauthorized effects.

discontinuity.description: Known interruption, loss, conflict, or divergence; absence of a value establishes no continuity.

uncertainty.description: Unsupported, inaccessible, or unresolved conditions without forced resolution.

representation_limits.description: Scope and limits of exposure; no external verification of an unexposed interior.
